svg.text: Red Hat OpenShift on bare metal
OpenShift Virtualization runs the VMs, so worker nodes must be bare metal
Validated Patterns Operator + Red Hat OpenShift GitOps (Argo CD)
installs the operators and syncs every application from Git, including one namespace, VM and inputs per user
saw-install: OpenShell by digest from the
OIDC tokens from Keycloak for users,
mTLS for the installer; podman driver;
Sandboxes: one container each, created by the gateway
